把订单核实成可执行的履约任务
note.en: Verify orders into executable fulfillment tasks

note.en: Pick from stock and pack into shippable parcels

note.en: Move freight in bulk between hubs

turns.zh: 把履约需求变成成本时效可控的作业计划
turns.en: Turn fulfillment demand into a cost- and time-controlled work plan

screens.zh: 能不能把成本、时效、库存的取舍算清楚，而不是只报一个方案
screens.en: Can they quantify the cost, speed, and inventory tradeoff rather than push one plan

asks.zh: 一条线路时效和成本冲突时你怎么定
asks.en: When lead time and cost conflict on a lane, how do you decide

asks.zh: 安全库存怎么设，依据是什么
asks.en: How do you set safety stock and on what basis

asks.zh: 讲一次你把履约成本降下来的具体做法
asks.en: Walk through one time you cut fulfillment cost

insider.zh: 强的人开口先问服务水平目标和货量结构，弱的人直接套一个模型
insider.en: Strong ones ask the service-level target and volume mix first

followups.zh: 货量翻倍这个方案还成立吗，瓶颈在哪
followups.en: Double the volume, does the plan hold, where's the bottleneck

turns.zh: 把订单和到货核成可拣配的准确任务
turns.en: Reconcile orders and receipts into accurate pick tasks

screens.zh: 单货核不核得准，账实不符时敢不敢拦下来查
screens.en: Do they reconcile paperwork to goods, and stop to investigate a mismatch

asks.zh: 收货时数量或批次对不上你怎么处理
asks.en: Count or lot doesn't match on receipt, what do you do

asks.zh: 怎么保证账面库存和实物一致
asks.en: How do you keep book inventory matching physical

insider.zh: 强的人分得清短装、错发、系统串号是三种不同的差异
insider.en: Strong ones treat a shortage, a mis-ship, and a system mismatch as three different problems

turns.zh: 按拣货单从库位取出订单货品
turns.en: Pull ordered items from bins per the pick list

screens.zh: 拣得快还要拣得对，错拣率压不压得住
screens.en: Pick fast and pick right, can they hold down mis-picks

asks.zh: 同时拣多单你怎么防止串货
asks.en: Picking multiple orders at once, how do you avoid mixing them

asks.zh: 拣货位缺货了你怎么办
asks.en: The pick face is empty, what do you do

insider.zh: 强的人会讲复核环节和批量拣货动线，弱的人只说自己手快
insider.en: Strong ones talk verification steps and batch-pick paths, not just being fast

turns.zh: 把拣齐的货品封装成待运包裹
turns.en: Pack picked items into shippable parcels

screens.zh: 会不会按货品选包装和缓冲，既保货又不浪费材料
screens.en: Do they match packaging and cushioning to the item, protecting goods without wasting material

asks.zh: 易碎品和重货你分别怎么打包
asks.en: How do you pack fragile versus heavy items

asks.zh: 怎么减少体积重量带来的运费
asks.en: How do you cut dimensional-weight shipping cost

insider.zh: 强的人知道包装尺寸直接影响抛重运费和破损率
insider.en: Strong ones know box size drives both dim-weight cost and damage rate

turns.zh: 把成品包裹码托并装车

screens.en: Load and move steadily and fast, with safety built into the habit

asks.en: In what order do you load a trailer

asks.zh: 看到行人和货架你怎么保持安全距离
asks.en: How do you keep safe distance from people and racks

insider.zh: 强的人码货先想卸货顺序和重心，弱的人只图装得满
insider.en: Strong ones load for the unload order and center of gravity, not just to fill

turns.en: Steer shift labor and throughput to the outbound target

screens.zh: 能不能在人手波动下把当班的出库指标顶住
screens.en: Can they hit the shift's outbound targets through labor swings

asks.en: Peak orders and short-staffed, how do you schedule and deploy

asks.zh: 一个班组产能持续掉队你怎么查
asks.en: A crew's output keeps lagging, how do you diagnose it

insider.zh: 强的人盯瓶颈工位和交接空档，弱的人只会催人加快
insider.en: Strong ones watch the bottleneck station and the handoff gaps, not just push people

turns.en: Schedule freight, trucks, and drivers into runnable trips

screens.zh: 能不能在车、货、时效、司机工时之间排出可执行的班次
screens.en: Can they build a runnable schedule across trucks, freight, deadlines, and driver hours

asks.zh: 一辆车临时抛锚你怎么补线路
asks.en: A truck breaks down mid-route, how do you re-cover it

asks.zh: 怎么在合规工时内把车辆利用率做高
asks.en: How do you raise utilization within legal driving hours

insider.zh: 强的人把司机合规工时当硬约束先排，弱的人只顾把货塞满车
insider.en: Strong ones treat hours-of-service as a hard constraint first, not just fill the truck

followups.zh: 多个急单抢同一辆车你怎么定优先级
followups.en: Several rush orders want the same truck, how do you prioritize

turns.zh: 把货物在枢纽间安全准点运达
turns.en: Haul freight between hubs safely and on time

screens.zh: 长途能不能安全准点，出行前检查和合规到不到位
screens.en: Can they run long-haul safe and on time, with pre-trip checks and compliance in place

asks.zh: 出车前你检查哪些项
asks.en: What do you check before rolling out

asks.zh: 遇到恶劣天气延误你怎么决定继续还是停
asks.en: On a weather delay, how do you decide to push on or hold

insider.zh: 强的人清楚超时驾驶的红线和后果，不会为赶点冒险
insider.en: Strong ones know the hours limit cold and won't gamble to make time

turns.zh: 把包裹按路区送到客户手中
turns.en: Deliver parcels along a route to customers

screens.zh: 一天几十上百个点，能不能又快又准还不惹客诉
screens.en: Dozens to hundreds of stops a day, fast and accurate without complaints

asks.zh: 客户不在家你怎么处理这一单
asks.en: The customer is not home, how do you handle the stop

asks.zh: 路区不熟你怎么排送货顺序
asks.en: Unfamiliar area, how do you sequence the stops

insider.zh: 强的人会主动留证留言降低纠纷，弱的人把包裹一放了事
insider.en: Strong ones leave proof and a note to head off disputes

turns.zh: 把妥投异常和退货处理成闭环
turns.en: Close out delivery exceptions and returns

screens.zh: 能不能快速定位货在哪、给出可信承诺并安抚情绪
screens.en: Can they locate the shipment fast, commit credibly, and calm the customer

asks.zh: 客户说没收到但系统显示已签收你怎么办
asks.en: Customer says not received but the system shows delivered, what do you do

asks.zh: 破损退货你走什么流程
asks.en: Damaged return, what is your process

insider.zh: 强的人分得清能承诺什么、要联动谁，弱的人只会道歉
insider.en: Strong ones know what they can promise and whom to loop in, not just apologize

Proof of delivery and exception report

note.en: Clerk moves to planning after picking up analysis

note.zh: 降压并把电能配送到用户

note.zh: 计量用电、出账并服务客户
note.en: Meter usage, issue bills, serve customers

turns.en: Convert fuel or renewables into grid-synced power

screens.en: Can they hold unit parameters steady and handle upsets by procedure, not instinct

asks.en: Load swings suddenly, how do you adjust the unit

insider.en: Strong ones read the trend before acting, not just silence the alarm

followups.zh: 调度让你顶峰但机组接近限值你怎么办
followups.en: Dispatch wants peak output but you're near a limit, what do you do

turns.zh: 把核裂变热能稳定转成基荷电力
turns.en: Turn reactor heat into steady baseload power

screens.en: Whether reverence for safety margins and procedure is absolute under output pressure

asks.en: Procedure conflicts with your read of the situation, what do you do

asks.zh: 反应堆功率异常你的第一反应是什么
asks.en: Reactor power anomaly, what is your first move

insider.zh: 强的人把守规程当第一位、把停堆当正常选项，弱的人怕担责拖着不停
insider.en: Strong ones treat a trip as a normal option, not a failure to avoid

turns.en: Keep turbines maintained and available to generate

screens.zh: 高空作业敢上还要修得对，故障判断准不准
screens.en: Will climb and fix it right, with sound fault diagnosis

asks.zh: 上塔前的安全准备你怎么做
asks.en: What is your safety prep before climbing

asks.zh: 叶片或齿轮箱异响你怎么排查
asks.en: Blade or gearbox noise, how do you trace it

insider.zh: 强的人先看数据和振动趋势再上塔，弱的人上去凭经验拆
insider.en: Strong ones read SCADA and vibration trends before climbing

turns.en: Model the grid into runnable limits and settings

screens.zh: 能不能把电网算准，给出的定值和限值经得起故障工况检验
screens.en: Can they model the grid so settings and limits hold under fault conditions

asks.en: A line needs uprating, what studies do you run

asks.zh: 继电保护定值你依据什么整定
asks.en: On what basis do you set relay protection

insider.zh: 强的人会把最严故障工况和保护配合一起算，弱的人只算稳态潮流
insider.en: Strong ones co-check worst-case faults with protection coordination, not just steady-state flow

followups.en: Interconnecting a large renewable plant, what worries you

turns.zh: 把发电和负荷实时调成平衡
turns.en: Balance generation against load in real time

screens.zh: 能不能在秒级维持发用平衡，故障时先隔离再恢复
screens.en: Can they hold generation-load balance in real time and isolate then restore on fault

asks.zh: 一条主干线路跳闸你怎么防止连锁停电
asks.en: A main line trips, how do you stop a cascading outage

asks.zh: 发用不平衡频率下降你怎么处置
asks.en: Frequency drops on imbalance, how do you respond

insider.zh: 强的人时刻留有备用容量和恢复路径，弱的人把系统开到没有裕度
insider.en: Strong ones always keep reserve and a restoration path, not run the system to zero margin

followups.zh: 既要消纳新能源又要稳频率你怎么调度
followups.en: Absorb renewables and hold frequency at once, how do you dispatch

screens.en: Can they repair substation gear and relays so re-energizing leaves no hidden fault

asks.en: What tests do you run before energizing a transformer

asks.zh: 保护误动和拒动你怎么排查区分
asks.en: How do you tell a false trip from a failure to trip

insider.zh: 强的人把带电作业的接地和验电当铁律，弱的人图快省步骤
insider.en: Strong ones treat grounding and voltage-check as inviolable before touching gear

screens.zh: 停电抢修能不能又快又安全，带电和验电规程是不是刻进本能
screens.en: Can they restore outages fast and safe, with clearance and test-before-touch as instinct

insider.zh: 强的人区分基线和促销拆预测，弱的人拍趋势
insider.en: Strong ones split baseline from promo, weak ones extrapolate a trend

turns.zh: 把产销两端协同成一个计划
turns.en: Aligns supply and demand into one plan

screens.zh: 跨部门协同和取舍
screens.en: Cross-functional alignment and trade-offs

asks.zh: 销售要货生产跟不上你怎么协调
asks.en: Sales wants more than production can make — how do you align it

insider.zh: 强的人用一套数拉齐各方，弱的人和稀泥
insider.en: Strong ones align everyone on one number, weak ones split the difference

turns.zh: 把计划变成到位的物料与产能
turns.en: Plans → materials and capacity in place

screens.zh: 供应保障和成本
screens.en: Supply assurance and cost

asks.zh: 关键物料断供你怎么保交付
asks.en: A key material is cut off — how do you protect delivery

insider.zh: 强的人备双源和安全库存，弱的人押单一供应商
insider.en: Strong ones keep dual sources and safety stock, weak ones bet on one supplier

turns.zh: 把库存和仓配管到高效履约
turns.en: Runs inventory and warehousing for efficient fulfillment

screens.zh: 库存周转和履约时效
screens.en: Inventory turns and fulfillment speed

asks.zh: 库存高又缺货你怎么解
asks.en: High stock yet stockouts — how do you fix it

insider.zh: 强的人按 SKU 分级管库存，弱的人一刀切
insider.en: Strong ones manage inventory by SKU class, weak ones treat all alike

gives.zh: 履约与偏差数据回流预测

tagline.zh: 一件跨境包裹走一条长链：国内揽收、报关出口、跨境干线、海外仓分拨、尾程派送；时效和清关异常回流到揽收和路由优化。
tagline.en: A cross-border parcel travels a long chain: domestic collection, export customs, international line-haul, overseas-warehouse sorting, last-mile delivery; transit-time and customs exceptions loop into collection and routing.

log-crossborder.frame: 跨境物流流程 · SCOR · O*NET SOC

note.zh: 行业全景：跨境电商物流的通例链路
note.en: Industry-wide: the generic cross-border e-com logistics chain

label.zh: 时效与清关异常 → 回流揽收与路由优化
label.en: transit-time & customs exceptions → collection and routing

turns.zh: 把货揽收集货交出口
turns.en: Collects and consolidates freight for export

screens.zh: 集货时效和成本
screens.en: Consolidation timing and cost

asks.zh: 小包多批次你怎么集货省成本
asks.en: Many small parcels — how do you consolidate to cut cost

insider.zh: 强的人按目的地和时效拼货，弱的人来一件走一件
insider.en: Strong ones consolidate by destination and SLA, weak ones ship piecemeal

turns.zh: 把货合规报关送出关
turns.en: Clears freight compliantly for export

screens.zh: 报关合规和归类准确
screens.en: Customs compliance and classification

asks.zh: 归类错被查你怎么处理
asks.en: A misclassification gets flagged — your handling

insider.zh: 强的人提前把品名归类做准，弱的人被扣才改
insider.en: Strong ones get classification right up front, weak ones fix it after a hold

turns.zh: 把货安排上空海运干线
turns.en: Books freight onto air/sea line-haul

screens.zh: 舱位资源和成本时效
screens.en: Space resources, cost, and transit

asks.zh: 旺季舱位紧张你怎么保时效
asks.en: Peak-season space is tight — how do you protect transit time

insider.zh: 强的人平时锁舱位资源，弱的人临时抢舱
insider.en: Strong ones lock space ahead, weak ones scramble at peak

turns.zh: 把海外仓入库分拨做顺
turns.en: Runs overseas inbound and sorting smoothly

screens.zh: 海外仓运营和本地协调
screens.en: Overseas-warehouse ops and local coordination

asks.zh: 海外仓爆仓你怎么处置
asks.en: The overseas hub is over capacity — your response

insider.zh: 强的人按销量预置海外库存，弱的人被动补货
insider.en: Strong ones pre-position stock by sales, weak ones restock reactively

turns.zh: 把尾程派送和签收管好
turns.en: Manages in-country delivery and receipt

screens.zh: 尾程服务商管理和时效
screens.en: Last-mile carrier management and speed

asks.zh: 目的国派送慢投诉多你怎么办
asks.en: Slow last-mile and rising complaints — now what

insider.zh: 强的人按签收率考核服务商，弱的人只看价格
insider.en: Strong ones judge carriers by delivery rate, weak ones only by price

gives.zh: 时效与清关异常回流揽收路由

tagline.zh: 行政运转从政策到落地：政策研究、发文决策、基层执行、督查反馈，一条自上而下的链；督查发现的问题回流到决策与政策修订。
tagline.en: Administration runs top-down from policy to the ground: research, decide and issue, execute at the grassroots, supervise; what supervision finds loops back into decisions and policy revision.

gov-agency.frame: 行政流程 · O*NET SOC · 政策执行链

note.zh: 行业全景：政府机关的通例政策执行链

label.zh: 督查发现的问题 → 回流决策与政策修订
label.en: supervision findings → decisions and policy revision

turns.zh: 把调研做成能落地的政策建议
turns.en: Research → actionable policy proposals

screens.zh: 调研深度和政策可行性
screens.en: Research depth and policy feasibility

asks.zh: 政策理想但基层难落地你怎么权衡
asks.en: A sound policy that's hard to implement — how do you weigh it

insider.zh: 强的人政策带着落地路径，弱的人只讲原则
insider.en: Strong ones bring an implementation path, weak ones state principles

turns.zh: 把材料和会务撑起来
turns.en: Runs documents and meetings

screens.zh: 文字功底和综合协调
screens.en: Writing and coordination

asks.zh: 多头材料同时催你怎么排
asks.en: Many documents due at once — how do you prioritize

insider.zh: 强的人材料一次过，弱的人反复改
insider.en: Strong ones get documents right the first time, weak ones cycle revisions

turns.zh: 把决策变成部署与发文
turns.en: Decisions → deployment and issuance

screens.zh: 行政判断和统筹能力
screens.en: Administrative judgment and coordination

asks.zh: 多部门意见不一你怎么统
asks.en: Departments disagree — how do you align them

insider.zh: 强的人平衡各方把事推成，弱的人卡在会签
insider.en: Strong ones balance parties and get it done, weak ones stall at sign-off

turns.zh: 把政策落到办事和服务
turns.en: Turns policy into service at the window

screens.zh: 执行力和群众沟通
screens.en: Execution and public communication

asks.zh: 政策和群众诉求冲突你怎么处理
asks.en: Policy clashes with a citizen's needs — your handling

insider.zh: 强的人把执行难点反馈上去，弱的人只按流程
insider.en: Strong ones feed execution pain upward, weak ones just follow the process

turns.zh: 把执行的问题督查出来
turns.en: Surfaces execution problems through review

screens.zh: 督查独立性和问题定位
screens.en: Supervision independence and problem-finding

asks.zh: 督查发现问题但涉及关系你怎么办
asks.en: You find a problem but relationships are involved — now what

insider.zh: 强的人对事不对人，弱的人和稀泥
insider.en: Strong ones judge the issue not the person, weak ones smooth it over

gives.zh: 督查问题回流决策修订

tagline.zh: 事业单位提供编制内的公共服务：职责立项、资源保障、服务提供、考核评估；考核结果回流到立项和资源配置。
tagline.en: Public institutions deliver mandated public services: mandate and plan, secure resources, deliver service, review; review outcomes loop into mandate and resourcing.

pub-institution.frame: 事业单位运转 · O*NET SOC · 公共服务

note.zh: 行业全景：事业单位的通例服务提供链
note.en: Industry-wide: the generic public-institution service chain

label.zh: 考核结果 → 回流立项与资源配置

turns.zh: 把职责立项成可执行的计划
turns.en: Mandate → executable plans

screens.zh: 公共服务判断和统筹
screens.en: Public-service judgment and coordination

asks.zh: 职责多资源少你怎么排优先级
asks.en: Many duties, few resources — how do you prioritize

insider.zh: 强的人按公众受益排序，弱的人按上级偏好
insider.en: Strong ones prioritize by public benefit, weak ones by superiors' preference

turns.zh: 把预算、人员与资源保障到位
turns.en: Secures budget, staffing, resources

screens.zh: 行政保障和规范意识
screens.en: Administrative support and compliance

asks.zh: 预算紧张你怎么保核心服务
asks.en: Budget is tight — how do you protect core services

insider.zh: 强的人把资源投到服务一线，弱的人平摊
insider.en: Strong ones put resources on the service front line, weak ones spread thin

turns.zh: 把服务提供给公众
turns.en: Delivers service to the public

screens.zh: 服务能力和群众沟通
screens.en: Service capability and public communication

asks.zh: 群众对服务不满你怎么改进
asks.en: The public is dissatisfied — how do you improve

insider.zh: 强的人从投诉里改流程，弱的人解释了事
insider.en: Strong ones fix processes from complaints, weak ones just explain

turns.zh: 把服务成效考核出来
turns.en: Reviews service effectiveness

screens.zh: 考核方法和结果运用
screens.en: Review methods and use of results

asks.zh: 考核流于形式你怎么改
asks.en: Reviews become a formality — how do you fix it

insider.zh: 强的人把考核结果用于改进，弱的人只填表
insider.en: Strong ones use results to improve, weak ones just fill forms

tagline.zh: 公益组织靠影响力和信任循环：募资筹款、项目设计、执行落地、影响力评估；影响力报告和受益反馈回流到募资与项目设计。
tagline.en: A nonprofit runs on impact and trust: fundraise, design programs, deliver, evaluate impact; impact reports and beneficiary feedback loop back into fundraising and design.

pub-nonprofit.frame: 公益项目流程 · O*NET SOC · 影响力闭环

note.zh: 行业全景：公益 / 社会组织的通例项目链
note.en: Industry-wide: the generic nonprofit program chain

label.zh: 影响力报告与受益反馈 → 回流募资

note.zh: 成效评估与影响力报告

turns.zh: 把使命讲成捐赠与资助
turns.en: Turns the mission into donations and grants

screens.zh: 筹款能力和捐赠人经营
screens.en: Fundraising and donor cultivation

asks.zh: 大额捐赠人流失你怎么挽回
asks.en: A major donor lapses — how do you win them back

insider.zh: 强的人靠影响力数据打动捐赠人，弱的人靠情怀
insider.en: Strong ones move donors with impact data, weak ones with sentiment

turns.zh: 把项目和影响力传播出去
turns.en: Communicates programs and impact

screens.zh: 传播能力和公信力把控
screens.en: Communications and credibility

asks.zh: 公益传播怎么避免消费苦难
asks.en: How do you communicate without exploiting suffering

insider.zh: 强的人守住受益人尊严，弱的人博眼球
insider.en: Strong ones protect beneficiaries' dignity, weak ones chase attention

turns.zh: 把需求设计成有效的公益项目
turns.en: Needs → effective programs

screens.zh: 项目设计和需求判断
screens.en: Program design and needs assessment

asks.zh: 捐赠人意愿和真实需求不符你怎么办
asks.en: Donor wishes diverge from real needs — now what

insider.zh: 强的人从受益人真实需求设计，弱的人照捐赠人偏好
insider.en: Strong ones design from beneficiary needs, weak ones from donor preference

turns.zh: 把项目落到受益人身上
turns.en: Delivers the program to beneficiaries

screens.zh: 执行力和一线服务
screens.en: Execution and frontline service

asks.zh: 项目落地和预期有差你怎么调
asks.en: Delivery diverges from plan — how do you adjust

insider.zh: 强的人把一线情况如实反馈，弱的人报喜不报忧
insider.en: Strong ones report the field honestly, weak ones only good news

turns.zh: 把项目成效评估成影响力报告
turns.en: Program outcomes → an impact report

screens.zh: 评估方法和成效衡量
screens.en: Evaluation methods and outcome measurement

asks.zh: 怎么衡量一个公益项目真的有用
asks.en: How do you measure whether a program truly helps

insider.zh: 强的人做前后对比和归因，弱的人只报数量
insider.en: Strong ones do before-after and attribution, weak ones report headcount

gives.zh: 产生影响力的公益项目

tagline.zh: 航班运行依次完成放行准备、地面保障、飞行执行与落地衔接。运行控制中心统筹天气、载重、机务、机组和空管信息，并在异常发生时协调后续航段。
tagline.en: Flight operations progress through dispatch preparation, ground handling, flight execution, and arrival coordination. The operations control center integrates weather, load, maintenance, crew, and air traffic control information, then coordinates downstream sectors when disruptions occur.

aviation.frame: 民航运行流程 · SIPOC · O*NET SOC

note.zh: 综合视角：以航空公司与基地机场的典型协作为主线，同时涵盖空管、安检等外部环节。
note.en: Combined view centered on typical airline and base-airport coordination, with external air traffic control and security screening stages included.

label.zh: 落地实际动态回到运行控制，重排下一段
label.en: actual arrival status → operations control, next sector replanned

note.zh: 算航路油量、看天气通告、配载出平衡表
note.en: route and fuel, weather and NOTAMs, loadsheet

note.zh: 航前检查与定检，交出可放行的飞机
note.en: pre-flight checks and base checks release the aircraft

note.zh: 旅客、行李、货物在过站时间里上机
note.en: passengers, bags and freight loaded inside the turn

note.zh: 机组执飞、客舱值勤、管制指挥
note.en: crew fly it, cabin on duty, ATC directs

note.zh: 航后检查、不正常航班处置与下一段衔接
note.en: post-flight checks, irregular ops, next-sector recovery

turns.zh: 把天气油量与飞机状态变成一份放行的飞行计划
turns.en: Weather, fuel and aircraft status → a signed release and flight plan

screens.zh: 放行决断，以及对天气、油量、备降的把握
screens.en: Release judgement on weather, fuel and alternates

asks.zh: 目的地天气在标准边缘、公司又压准点，你放不放行
asks.en: Destination weather is marginal and the airline is pushing on-time — do you release

asks.zh: 备降场你按什么条件选
asks.en: How do you pick the alternate

insider.zh: 强的人先把最低燃油和备降条件算死再谈准点，弱的人跟着系统给的默认值走
insider.en: Strong ones fix minimum fuel and alternate criteria before discussing punctuality; weak ones accept the system defaults

turns.zh: 把旅客行李货物配成一张合规的载重平衡表
turns.en: Passengers, bags and freight → a compliant loadsheet

screens.zh: 重心计算的准确度，改配后有没有复核习惯
screens.en: Trim accuracy and the habit of re-checking after a load change

asks.zh: 临登机口加了两吨货、重心超了，你怎么处理
asks.en: Two tonnes added at the gate and the CG is out — what do you do

asks.zh: 实际装载与舱单不符你从哪查
asks.en: Actual loading disagrees with the manifest — where do you look

insider.zh: 强的人每次改配都重算并让机长复签，弱的人只改数字不重算
insider.en: Strong ones recompute and get the captain to re-sign on every change; weak ones just edit the number

turns.zh: 把复训考核变成合格有效的机组资质
turns.en: Recurrent training and checks → current, valid crew qualifications

screens.zh: 训练计划与资质到期的管控
screens.en: Control of the training plan and expiring ratings

asks.zh: 复训窗口和航班排班撞了你怎么排
asks.en: Recurrent windows clash with the roster — how do you schedule

asks.zh: 一名机长模拟机没过你怎么处理
asks.en: A captain fails the simulator check — what happens next

insider.zh: 强的人拿运行数据定训练重点，弱的人按手册最低要求排满
insider.en: Strong ones set training focus from operational data; weak ones just fill the manual minimum

turns.zh: 把过站的飞机检查到可以放行
turns.en: Inspects the aircraft on the ramp until it can be released

screens.zh: 短过站时间里的排故判断和放行胆量
screens.en: Fault judgement and release nerve inside a short turn

asks.zh: 过站三十分钟发现液压渗漏你放不放行
asks.en: Thirty-minute turn, a hydraulic leak shows up — do you release

asks.zh: 保留故障项目你按什么依据挂
asks.en: On what basis do you defer a fault

insider.zh: 强的人按最低设备清单说清能不能带故障飞，弱的人凭经验说没事
insider.en: Strong ones argue it from the MEL; weak ones say it looks fine from experience

turns.zh: 把到期的飞机按工卡修回适航状态
turns.en: Works the check cards until the aircraft is airworthy again

screens.zh: 按工卡干活的规范性和记录完整度
screens.en: Discipline against the work card and completeness of records

asks.zh: 工卡步骤和实际结构不一致你怎么办
asks.en: The card step does not match the actual structure — now what

asks.zh: 拆开发现超手册的损伤你走什么流程
asks.en: You open it up and the damage is beyond manual limits — what process

insider.zh: 强的人先停下来开工程请求，弱的人自己想办法装回去
insider.en: Strong ones stop and raise an engineering request; weak ones improvise it back together

turns.zh: 把排队的旅客变成登机牌与托运行李
turns.en: Queues → boarding passes and checked bags

screens.zh: 大面积延误时的沟通和改签处置
screens.en: Communication and rebooking under a mass delay

asks.zh: 航班取消一百多人围在柜台你先做什么
asks.en: Flight cancelled, a hundred people at the counter — what first

asks.zh: 超售没有座位了你怎么谈
asks.en: Oversold with no seat left — how do you handle it

insider.zh: 强的人先把可用的后续航班和补偿口径摸清再开口，弱的人只会重复公司规定
insider.en: Strong ones learn the available onward flights and compensation rules before speaking; weak ones just recite policy

turns.zh: 把散货变成能上机的板箱与运单
turns.en: Loose freight → built ULDs and air waybills

screens.zh: 组板配载和单货一致的把控
screens.en: ULD build-up and keeping paperwork matched to the freight

asks.zh: 货物重量与运单不符你怎么处理
asks.en: The weight disagrees with the waybill — how do you handle it

asks.zh: 板型超限进不了货舱你怎么改
asks.en: The built pallet is out of contour for the hold — how do you rebuild it

insider.zh: 强的人组板时按机型舱位算高度和重量分布，弱的人堆满了再想
insider.en: Strong ones build to the aircraft contour and weight spread; weak ones stack it full and think later

turns.zh: 把放行的航班飞到目的地并安全落地
turns.en: Flies the released sector and lands it safely

screens.zh: 标准操作程序的执行，以及边界条件下的决断
screens.en: SOP discipline and decision-making at the limits

asks.zh: 进近时风切变告警你怎么处置
asks.en: Windshear warning on approach — your actions

asks.zh: 机械故障和准点冲突你怎么决定
asks.en: A technical fault against on-time performance — how do you decide

insider.zh: 强的人复飞说走就走不犹豫，弱的人想着能不能压一把落下去
insider.en: Strong ones go around without hesitating; weak ones try to squeeze the landing in

turns.zh: 把客舱做到能应急、旅客能安坐
turns.en: Keeps the cabin ready for an emergency and the passengers seated safely

screens.zh: 应急处置能力，以及客舱冲突的处理
screens.en: Emergency handling and dealing with cabin conflict

asks.zh: 两名旅客在客舱吵起来还不听劝你怎么办
asks.en: Two passengers are arguing and will not listen — what do you do

asks.zh: 客舱释压你的动作顺序是什么
asks.en: Cabin decompression — what is your sequence

insider.zh: 强的人先把安全动作做完再谈服务，弱的人先想着别得罪旅客
insider.en: Strong ones complete the safety actions before service; weak ones start from not upsetting anyone

turns.zh: 把同时进出的航空器排出安全间隔
turns.en: Sequences simultaneous traffic into safe separation

screens.zh: 高负荷下的间隔保持和指令清晰度
screens.en: Holding separation and issuing clear instructions under load

asks.zh: 两架航空器间隔快不够了你怎么调
asks.en: Separation is about to be lost — how do you fix it

asks.zh: 机组复诵不对你怎么纠
asks.en: The readback is wrong — how do you correct it

insider.zh: 强的人指令短、有优先级、一遍听得懂，弱的人话多还要机组猜
insider.en: Strong ones give short, prioritised, first-time-clear instructions; weak ones talk a lot and leave the crew guessing

turns.zh: 把延误和故障变成能执行的航班调整方案
turns.en: Delays and faults → a workable schedule recovery

screens.zh: 不正常航班时的全局取舍
screens.en: Whole-network trade-offs during irregular operations

asks.en: The airport closes on weather and a dozen flights back up — in what order do you recover

asks.zh: 机组超时和航班取消你怎么权衡
asks.en: Crew duty limits against cancelling the flight — how do you weigh it

insider.zh: 强的人先算机组时限和过夜保障能力，弱的人一架架单独救
insider.en: Strong ones start from duty limits and overnight capacity; weak ones rescue one aircraft at a time

turns.zh: 把不安全事件变成查清根因的整改项
turns.en: Safety events → root causes and closed corrective actions

screens.zh: 不安全事件调查的深度和整改闭环
screens.en: Depth of investigation and closure of corrective actions

asks.zh: 同类事件半年内又发生你怎么查根因
asks.en: The same event recurs within six months — how do you find the root cause

asks.zh: 一线不愿意报告隐患你怎么改
asks.en: Front-line staff stop reporting hazards — how do you change that

insider.zh: 强的人查到程序和排班这一层，弱的人停在人员违规
insider.en: Strong ones get down to procedure and rostering; weak ones stop at individual violation

gives.zh: 复训合格、可以排班的机组资质
gives.en: Current crew qualifications available for rostering

gives.zh: 定检出厂、状态完好的飞机
gives.en: An aircraft out of base check, serviceable

gives.zh: 航前检查合格的飞机与技术记录本
gives.en: A pre-flight-checked aircraft plus its tech log

gives.zh: 签好的放行单与飞行计划
gives.en: The signed release and flight plan

gives.zh: 办好登机牌、过完安检登机的旅客
实际装载的行李与货物数据
客舱准备与起飞前的指令

gives.en: Passengers off the aircraft at destination

gives.zh: 飞行中发现的故障，写进技术记录本
gives.en: In-flight faults written into the tech log

gives.zh: 落地实际时刻与航班动态
gives.en: Actual on-block times and flight status

gives.zh: 调整后的航班计划与衔接方案
gives.en: The adjusted schedule and recovery plan

gives.zh: 改签与后续航班的处置口径
事件调查结论与运行风险提示
gives.en: Investigation findings and operational risk notices

gives.zh: 按事件定出的训练与复训重点

note.zh: 配载岗考签派执照转运行控制
note.en: load control → dispatch with the licence

客运服务转运行指挥中心
机库定检攒够经历考放行证转航线

tagline.zh: 海运交付需要商务、单证与报关、港口、甲板、轮机和岸基管理同步就绪；船舶代理负责港口协同，安全审核与事故调查推动船岸整改。
tagline.en: Maritime delivery requires chartering, documentation and customs, port services, deck operations, engineering, and shore management to be ready in parallel. Ship agents coordinate each port call, while safety audits and incident investigations drive corrective action on board and ashore.

shipping.frame: 海运集装箱流程 · SCOR · SIPOC · O*NET SOC

note.zh: 综合视角：以出口集装箱运输为主线，同时涵盖船东、船舶管理、港口和船舶代理等多主体协作。
note.en: Combined view centered on export-container transport, including collaboration among shipowners, ship managers, ports, and shipping agents.

label.en: findings → shore management, into rectification and drydock

note.en: berth plan, pilotage, handling and tally

note.en: stowage and stability, navigational watch, port preparation

note.en: main and auxiliary machinery available, engine watch

note.en: marine and technical superintendence, drydock and spares

screens.zh: 港口手续的熟练度和多方协调能力
screens.en: Fluency with port formalities and coordinating several parties

asks.zh: 船到港泊位被占你怎么安排
asks.en: The berth is occupied when the ship arrives — how do you arrange it

asks.zh: 船员急需就医你怎么办手续
asks.en: A crew member needs urgent medical care — how do you arrange it

insider.zh: 强的人预抵前就把引航拖轮和物料排好，弱的人等船到了才打电话
insider.en: Strong ones have pilot, tugs and stores booked before the ETA; weak ones start phoning after the ship arrives

turns.zh: 把货和船配上，谈成一个不亏的航次
turns.en: Matches cargo and ship into a voyage that pays

screens.zh: 航次估算和租约条款的风险判断
screens.en: Voyage estimating and reading risk in charter terms

asks.zh: 运价跌了船东要撤租你怎么谈
asks.en: Rates drop and the owner wants out — how do you negotiate

asks.zh: 这个航次亏不亏你怎么算
asks.en: How do you work out whether this voyage loses money

insider.zh: 强的人把滞期和燃油差价算进航次估算，弱的人只看运价
insider.en: Strong ones price demurrage and bunker spread into the estimate; weak ones look only at the freight rate

turns.zh: 把订舱变成提单单证和报关资料
turns.en: A booking → bills of lading and customs paperwork

screens.zh: 提单与单据的严谨度
screens.en: Precision on bills of lading and supporting documents

asks.zh: 提单收货人写错了船已开你怎么改
asks.en: The consignee is wrong and the ship has sailed — how do you amend it

asks.zh: 无提单放货客户来施压你怎么办
asks.en: The customer pushes for release without the bill of lading

insider.zh: 强的人改单前先看放货责任落在谁身上，弱的人先答应客户
insider.en: Strong ones check where release liability lands before amending; weak ones agree with the customer first

turns.zh: 把申报的货物报到海关放行
turns.en: Files the entry until the goods are released

screens.zh: 归类申报的准确度和查验处置
screens.en: Accuracy of classification and handling an inspection hold

asks.zh: 商品归类有两种口径你按哪个报
asks.en: Two defensible classifications — which one do you file

asks.zh: 货被查验扣了赶不上船期你怎么办
asks.en: The cargo is held for inspection and will miss the ship

insider.zh: 强的人报关前先核对品名规格和监管条件，弱的人照客户给的抄
insider.en: Strong ones verify description, spec and control conditions first; weak ones copy what the customer sent

turns.zh: 把到港的船排进泊位和装卸计划
turns.en: Arriving ships → berths and a handling plan

screens.zh: 泊位与机械资源的取舍
screens.en: Trading off berths against crane and gang capacity

asks.zh: 两条船同时抢一个泊位你先放哪条
asks.en: Two ships want the same berth — which goes first

asks.zh: 天气窗口只剩半天你怎么调作业
asks.en: Only half a day of weather window left — how do you re-plan

insider.zh: 强的人按船型作业量和潮水排序，弱的人按到港顺序排
insider.en: Strong ones sequence by ship size, workload and tide; weak ones sequence by arrival order

turns.zh: 把大船从航道带到泊位靠妥
turns.en: Conns a large ship from the channel onto the berth

screens.zh: 受限水域的操船判断
screens.en: Ship handling judgement in confined water

asks.zh: 进港途中主机故障你怎么处置
asks.en: Main engine failure inbound — your actions

asks.zh: 风流压差大靠泊你怎么带
asks.en: Strong wind and current on berthing — how do you take her in

insider.zh: 强的人上船先问操纵特性和实际吃水，弱的人当所有船一个手法
insider.en: Strong ones ask about handling characteristics and actual draft on boarding; weak ones treat every ship the same

turns.zh: 把装卸的箱货点清并核对单据残损
turns.en: Tallies the boxes and cargo, checks documents and damage

screens.zh: 单货核对和残损认定
screens.en: Matching cargo to paperwork and recording damage

asks.zh: 卸下来的箱数与舱单不符你怎么处理
asks.en: The discharged count disagrees with the manifest

asks.zh: 货物有明显残损谁来担你怎么记
asks.en: Cargo is visibly damaged — how do you record who carries it

insider.zh: 强的人现场就把残损拍照批注上单，弱的人事后补记
insider.en: Strong ones photograph and note damage on the spot; weak ones write it up afterwards

turns.zh: 把船和这票货安全带到卸港
turns.en: Brings ship and cargo safely to the discharge port

screens.zh: 全船安全责任和货物积载判断
screens.en: Command responsibility and judgement on stowage

asks.zh: 恶劣天气要不要改航路你怎么定
asks.en: Heavy weather ahead — do you divert, and on what basis

asks.zh: 装货港要求超载装你怎么处理
asks.en: The load port wants you loaded beyond limits

insider.zh: 强的人算完稳性和强度再签积载图，弱的人先看装多少
insider.en: Strong ones check stability and strength before signing the stowage plan; weak ones start from how much fits

turns.zh: 把航行值班和进出港准备做到位
turns.en: Keeps the watch and gets the ship ready for port

screens.zh: 值班航行的规范和设备熟悉度
screens.en: Watchkeeping discipline and knowledge of the equipment

asks.zh: 雷达上出现碰撞危险你按什么规则避
asks.en: A collision risk appears on radar — which rule do you apply

asks.zh: 航次前海图和航行通告你怎么改正
asks.en: How do you correct charts and notices before the voyage

insider.zh: 强的人交接班前把本班的通航风险点标出来，弱的人到点上驾驶台
insider.en: Strong ones mark the watch's navigational risks before handover; weak ones just show up on the bridge

turns.zh: 把机舱机械管到全程可用
turns.en: Keeps engine-room machinery available for the whole voyage

screens.zh: 机舱全局判断和维修安排
screens.en: Whole-plant judgement and planning repairs

asks.zh: 主机滑油压力下降你怎么处置
asks.en: Main engine lube oil pressure is falling — your actions

asks.zh: 备件到不了下一港你怎么办
asks.en: The spare will not reach the next port

insider.zh: 强的人按趋势数据提前安排修理，弱的人等报警了才动
insider.en: Strong ones plan repairs off trend data; weak ones wait for the alarm

turns.zh: 把值班机械的故障处理在航次里
turns.en: Clears watch machinery faults within the voyage

screens.zh: 值班排故和管系熟悉度
screens.en: Watch troubleshooting and knowledge of the piping

asks.zh: 辅机跳车你按什么顺序查
asks.en: The auxiliary engine trips — in what order do you check

asks.zh: 舱底水系统报警你怎么处置
asks.en: A bilge system alarm — your actions

insider.zh: 强的人熟悉本船每条管路的走向，弱的人只会照手册翻
insider.en: Strong ones know where every line on their ship runs; weak ones can only page through the manual

turns.zh: 把岸上的航行安全要求落到船上
turns.en: Turns shore safety requirements into practice on board

screens.zh: 港口国检查缺陷的整改闭环
screens.en: Closing out port state control findings

asks.zh: 一条船连续两次被查出同类缺陷你怎么办
asks.en: The same class of deficiency is found twice on one ship

asks.zh: 船长和公司程序有冲突你听谁的
asks.en: The master and the company procedure disagree — whom do you follow

insider.zh: 强的人上船先看记录和演习真不真，弱的人只查文件签没签
insider.en: Strong ones check whether records and drills are real; weak ones check only whether the paperwork is signed

turns.zh: 把船舶机械状态管成坞修与备件计划
turns.en: Machinery condition → a drydock scope and spares plan

screens.zh: 坞修范围与维修预算的把控
screens.en: Control of drydock scope and repair budget

asks.zh: 坞修预算不够你砍哪些项目
asks.en: The drydock budget is short — what do you cut

asks.zh: 一台设备反复坏你怎么定改造方案
asks.en: A machine keeps failing — how do you settle a modification

insider.zh: 强的人按状态数据定坞修范围，弱的人按上次坞修清单抄
insider.en: Strong ones set scope from condition data; weak ones copy the last docking list

turns.zh: 把内审和事故调查变成关闭的不符合项
turns.en: Audits and investigations → non-conformities closed out

screens.zh: 体系内审的独立性和事故调查深度
screens.en: Independence in auditing and depth of investigation

asks.zh: 内审开出的不符合项船上不认你怎么办
asks.en: The ship disputes your non-conformity — what then

asks.zh: 一起机损事故你怎么定根因
asks.en: A machinery damage case — how do you settle the root cause

insider.zh: 强的人查到程序本身写得不能执行这一层，弱的人只写船员未按程序
insider.en: Strong ones find that the procedure itself cannot be followed; weak ones just write down that the crew did not follow it

gives.zh: 定好船期与运价的订舱确认
gives.en: A booking confirmed with schedule and rate

gives.zh: 报关用的箱单发票与提单资料
gives.en: Packing list, invoice and bill of lading data for the entry

gives.zh: 海关放行、可以进场装船的货
gives.en: Cargo released and free to enter the terminal

gives.zh: 船舶预抵报告与靠泊申请
gives.en: The ETA notice and berth application

gives.zh: 进出港航道的引领与靠离泊操纵
按积载图装完的货与舱单
gives.en: Cargo loaded to the stowage plan, with the manifest
The voyage plan and watch bill

gives.zh: 机舱值班表与保养计划
gives.en: The engine watch bill and maintenance plan

gives.zh: 可用的主机功率与航速
航行安全指令与体系程序
gives.en: Navigational safety instructions and company procedures

gives.zh: 靠妥开舱、可以卸货的船
gives.en: A ship berthed and hatches open for discharge

gives.zh: 卸清点交、单货一致的这票货
gives.en: The consignment discharged, tallied and matched to paperwork

gives.zh: 换单放货后的提货凭证
gives.en: The release order handed to the consignee

gives.zh: 航次报告与事故隐患报告
gives.en: Voyage reports and hazard or casualty reports

gives.zh: 内审开出的不符合项与整改要求
打回船上的整改项与修订后的程序
gives.en: Corrections sent back to the ship, with revised procedures

gives.zh: 机械状态报告与备件申请
gives.en: Machinery condition reports and spares requisitions

note.en: watchkeeping officer → chief mate and master

note.zh: 船长下船转岸基海务监督

tagline.zh: 矿石从矿体走到精矿堆场，一站一站往前：先找矿定住储量，再出采矿设计，然后采掘、选别、把尾矿处置掉。安全条线横贯全程，画法上挂在各站下面：通风与安全管理决定每一站能不能开工，一旦监测超限或查出隐患，问题就回到设计与采掘计划。
tagline.en: Ore moves from the orebody to the concentrate pile station by station: prove the resource, design the mine, extract, concentrate, dispose of tailings. Safety runs across all of it and hangs off the stages it gates — ventilation and safety management decide whether a stage may run at all, and a monitoring exceedance or a hazard finding pushes the problem back into design and the mining plan.

mining.frame: 矿山生产流程 · SIPOC · O*NET SOC

note.zh: 行业全景：金属与煤矿的通例生产链，不指某一座矿山；安全条线按支撑席位画，不占独立环节
note.en: Industry-wide: the generic metal and coal mine production chain; safety is drawn as support seats, not a stage

label.zh: 隐患与监测超限回流设计与采掘计划
label.en: hazards and exceedances loop back into design

note.zh: 找矿、钻探取样与储量评估
开拓、采矿方法与通风系统设计
井下或露天开采、钻爆与品位控制
note.en: underground or open-pit mining, drill and blast, grade control

note.zh: 碎磨浮选与化验，选出精矿
尾矿安全封存与回水复用
note.en: safe storage of tailings, water reclaim

turns.zh: 把野外线索变成能圈住的找矿靶区
turns.en: Field clues become a drillable target

screens.zh: 野外独立填图与判断有没有矿的能力
screens.en: Independent field mapping and calling whether there is ore

asks.zh: 一片化探异常你怎么判断值不值得布钻
asks.en: A geochem anomaly — how do you decide whether to drill it

asks.zh: 资料少、露头差，你靠什么定下一步工作
asks.en: Thin data, poor outcrop — what drives your next step

insider.zh: 强的人先把区域成矿背景想清楚再布工程，弱的人跟着异常打孔
insider.en: Strong ones settle the regional model before laying out holes, weak ones chase anomalies

turns.zh: 把布钻方案变成岩心与可用的钻孔数据
turns.en: A drill plan becomes core and usable hole data

screens.zh: 钻进工艺选择与岩心采取率的把控
screens.en: Drilling method choice and core recovery

asks.zh: 岩心采取率上不去你怎么调
asks.en: Core recovery stays low — what do you change

insider.zh: 强的人按地层换钻具和泥浆，弱的人一套参数打到底
insider.en: Strong ones swap bits and mud by formation, weak ones run one setup all the way

name.zh: 储量与资源评估工程师

turns.zh: 把钻孔数据变成经得起评审的储量
turns.en: Hole data becomes a reserve that survives review

screens.zh: 品位建模方法的选择与评审经验
screens.en: Grade-estimation method choice and review experience

asks.zh: 品位估值方法你怎么选，又怎么验证
asks.en: How do you pick an estimation method and validate it

asks.zh: 储量核实被评审专家质疑你怎么应
asks.en: Reviewers challenge your reserve statement — your response

insider.zh: 强的人拿生产实际反算模型偏差，弱的人只交软件出的报表
insider.en: Strong ones reconcile the model against production, weak ones hand in the software report

turns.zh: 把储量变成能施工的开拓与采矿方案
turns.en: A reserve becomes a buildable development and mining plan

screens.zh: 采矿方法选择与技术经济比较
screens.en: Mining-method selection and techno-economic comparison

asks.zh: 同一矿体两种采矿方法你怎么比
asks.en: Two candidate methods for one orebody — how do you compare them

asks.zh: 设计的贫化率与损失率你按什么定
asks.en: How do you set planned dilution and ore loss

insider.zh: 强的人把通风、排水与地压一起算进方案，弱的人只画采场
insider.en: Strong ones fold ventilation, drainage and ground stress into the design, weak ones just draw stopes

turns.zh: 把井上下实际变成图纸与采剥量账
turns.en: The real workings become plans and a volume reconciliation

screens.zh: 控制测量精度与量方核算的严谨
screens.en: Control-survey accuracy and rigour in volume reconciliation

asks.zh: 井下导线闭合差超限你怎么处理
asks.en: An underground traverse busts its closure tolerance — what now

insider.zh: 强的人的测量成果能直接支撑结算，弱的人只交一堆坐标
insider.en: Strong ones' survey work stands up in settlement, weak ones hand over coordinates

turns.zh: 把设计变成月度采掘计划与出矿量
turns.en: Design becomes a monthly mine plan and tonnes out

screens.zh: 现场支护判断与采掘计划的可执行性
screens.en: Ground-support judgement and whether the plan can actually be run

asks.zh: 采场顶板来压你怎么处置
asks.en: The back starts taking load — your response

asks.zh: 计划出矿量完不成你从哪找原因
asks.en: You miss planned tonnes — where do you look

insider.zh: 强的人排计划时留出准备工程，弱的人把工作面吃干榨净
insider.en: Strong ones keep development ahead of production, weak ones mine the faces dry

turns.zh: 把台阶剥采计划变成稳定的出矿量
turns.en: Bench and strip plans become steady ore supply

screens.zh: 剥采比控制与边坡稳定意识
screens.en: Strip-ratio control and slope-stability awareness

asks.zh: 边坡出现位移你怎么办
asks.en: The slope starts moving — what do you do

tagline.zh: 铁水和钢水在工序之间连着流，停不下来：烧结焦化备料、高炉炼铁、转炉或电炉炼钢加精炼、连铸、轧钢成材，末端由热处理与理化检验判定放行。前一道的产出就是后一道的入料，节奏还被下游卡着，铸机的浇次计划反过来定炼钢什么时候出钢；高炉一点火要连着跑好几年，任何一处停下来，上游只能憋着或者放散。
tagline.en: Molten iron and steel flow between units and cannot be paused: sinter and coke prepare the burden, the blast furnace makes iron, BOF or EAF plus secondary refining make steel, the caster casts, the mills roll it to product, and heat treatment plus lab testing release it. Each unit's output is the next one's feed, and the tempo is set from downstream — the caster's sequence dictates when the furnace taps. A blast furnace runs for years once lit, and when anything stops, upstream has to hold or flare.

tagline.zh: 这条链常年不断，不按订单一单一单走：场站厂区制出合格的水、气与热，调度盯着全网压力流量决定怎么送，管网把它输配到小区和楼栋，报装与客服守在表前这一端。用户报修与投诉定位出的管网问题回流到管网与场站，成为下一轮整改的输入。
tagline.en: This chain runs around the clock rather than order by order: gas and raw water come in, plants and stations produce compliant water, gas and heat, dispatch watches network pressure and flow to decide how to push it out, the network distributes to neighbourhoods and risers, and connections, safety inspection, meter reading and customer service sit at the meter. Complaints and inspection findings flow back into the network and the plants as the next round of fixes.

tagline.zh: 一颗卫星或者一发火箭是一次收敛式研制：总体设计把任务需求分解成各专业的指标与接口，结构热控、动力、电气综合电子、制导控制与软件几条线并行推进，最后在总装测试汇到一起。环境试验与飞行试验暴露的问题按归零流程打回对应专业，接口和裕度都攥在总体设计手里。
tagline.en: A satellite or a launcher converges: overall design breaks mission needs into per-discipline requirements and interfaces; structure and thermal, propulsion, avionics, and GNC plus onboard software run in parallel; everything comes together at assembly, integration and test. Problems found in environmental and flight testing are pushed back to the owning discipline through formal closure, and interfaces and margins live with overall design.

tagline.zh: 客户拿一个产品来，这里做出一副能量产的模具：报价与模流先判断做不做得出来，设计出图，加工出模具零件，装配后上机试模，合格了才交给成型量产。试模不合格就回头改模，改到出得了合格件为止，这一段返工是这行真正的成本所在。
tagline.en: A customer brings a part; the shop delivers a mold that can run production: quoting and flow analysis judge feasibility, design releases drawings, machining cuts the steel, tryout runs it on a press, and only a passing mold goes to production molding. Failed tryouts loop back into rework — that loop is where the real cost sits.

keystone.en: A mold that runs production reliably

label.zh: 试模不合格回头改模改图

tagline.zh: 纱到成衣走的是连续工艺流：纺纱、织造、印染整一道接一道，前一道的产出就是后一道的入料，色差和手感在这几道里定型，后面补不回来。面料交出去之后节奏换了一次——制版打样按款走，裁剪车缝按大货批量走，跟单在中间守住交期与品质。
tagline.en: Yarn to garment runs as a continuous process: spinning, weaving and dyeing hand material straight down the line, and shade and hand are set here — later stages cannot recover them. Once fabric ships the rhythm changes: patterns and samples move style by style, cutting and sewing move by bulk order, with merchandising holding delivery and quality in between.

tagline.zh: 纸机一开就是连续流：制浆、抄纸、涂布不能停，停一次开机损耗就出来了。纸做出来之后分两路并行准备——包装结构设计定盒型与用料，印前制版把稿子拼成能上机的版，两边齐了才开印，印后模切装订收尾。印刷品质在开机后当场判，色差与套印偏差是当场停机处理的事。
tagline.en: A paper machine runs continuously: pulping, forming and coating cannot stop without eating the start-up loss. Once paper exists, two threads run in parallel — structural design sets the box and the board, prepress imposes plates that can go on press — and only when both are ready does the run start, with die-cutting and binding closing it out. Print quality is called at the press: shade and register are judged and stopped on the spot.

tagline.zh: 定制家居这条链的起点和终点都在客户家里：先上门量尺，再出方案与效果图，签单后把图拆成一块块板件的生产单，开料封边打孔做出来，包装发货，最后上门安装装完才算交付。量错一个尺寸、拆错一块板，代价都在安装现场付，所以返工回流是这行最贵的一课。
tagline.en: In custom furniture the chain starts and ends in the customer's home: measure on site, present a scheme and renders, then split the signed drawing into panel-level production orders, cut, edge and drill them, pack and ship, and finally install — delivery only counts once it is fitted. A wrong measurement or a wrong split is paid for on site, which makes the rework loop the most expensive lesson in this trade.

tagline.zh: 医美的账不在第一单上。买流量、把询单约到院、面诊签单、医生做治疗，一个新客要摊掉很重的获客成本，首单常常只够打平；靠术后回访攒下信任、老客复购和转介绍回到获客这一端，轮子才转得起来。口腔的疗程复诊和视光的定期复查也是这么转起来的，所以放在同一张轮子上。
tagline.en: In aesthetics the money is not in the first ticket. Traffic is bought, leads are booked into the clinic, consultants close, doctors treat — a new customer carries heavy acquisition cost and the first sale often only breaks even; trust built in aftercare turns into repeat treatments and referrals that flow back into acquisition, and only then does the wheel pay. Dental recalls and optometry check-ups run the same loop, so they sit on the same wheel.

tagline.zh: 流动的是来访者：预约初筛先判断适不适合做咨询，配上合适的咨询师，做初始评估与个案概念化，然后按周推进会谈，风险高的走危机通道，最后结案与随访。督导横在整条线上看个案，把技术和伦理关口守住。保密、知情同意、双重关系回避与危机时的保密例外是这行的硬约束，从第一通电话就开始适用。
tagline.en: The client is what flows: intake screens whether counseling fits, a counselor is matched, initial assessment and case formulation set the goals, sessions run week by week, high-risk cases go down the crisis channel, and the case closes with follow-up. Supervision runs across the whole line, holding the technical and ethical gates. Confidentiality, informed consent, avoidance of dual relationships and the duty-to-warn exception bind every stop, starting with the first phone call.

tagline.zh: 宠物医疗与服务围绕宠物及其饲主展开：医疗路径涵盖接诊、检验、诊断、治疗和复诊，日常服务涵盖寄养、训练与商品零售；兽医负责统筹医疗方案、风险沟通和费用安排。
tagline.en: Pet care centers on the animal and its owner. The clinical pathway covers intake, diagnostics, treatment, and follow-up, while routine services include boarding, training, and retail. Veterinarians coordinate care plans, risk communication, and cost decisions.

tagline.zh: 内容与口碑形成出行需求，产品和计调完成线路、交通、住宿与餐饮安排，销售渠道组织成行，现场服务团队负责交付体验；游客评价和内容反馈影响后续获客与产品优化。
tagline.en: Content and reputation generate travel demand. Product and tour operations arrange itineraries, transport, accommodation, and dining; sales channels assemble bookings; and on-site teams deliver the experience. Traveler reviews and content then influence future acquisition and product improvement.
